glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 扌 (= 手) (“hand”) + phonetic 戈. Originally a variant form of 划. Borrowed to mean a similar action. The popular interpretation as a hand (扌) looking for a halberd (戈) is a mnemonic and not the origin of the character.
senses: [zhǎo] to ask for somebody; to call on somebody
